gates.name: Run the sample in both roles
gates.reason: build/Test-SampleRoundTrip.ps1 P/Invokes libc's kill(2) to send real POSIX signals (documented in the script's own header as deliberate, since .NET/PowerShell have no SIGTERM expression), which only resolves on Linux; this worktree is Windows. Running it anyway got as far as 'Both roles served their probes in Production.' (the actual round-trip assertion) before the script's own kill-based cleanup path threw 'Exception calling "kill" with "2" argument(s): "Value cannot be null. (Parameter 'path1')"' and exited 1. The corresponding CI check on the pull request (job build, ubuntu-latest) is where this gate's real answer comes from.
